data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1969 experienced a $9.07 million strengthening of prior year reserves in 2019, representing a 1.6% deterioration relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years, specifically in the Non-Marine Liability class, due to large losses, increased frequency of claims, and a higher percentage of insureds making claims in the 2018 year of account.

adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years in the Non-Marine Liability class
prior year deterioration on Non-Marine Liability, predominantly on specific large claims

The 2018 year of account has experienced further adverse loss experience in the US Open market sub-class from a number of individual large losses. We have seen an increase in the frequency of claims and a higher percentage of insureds making claims.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of $9.07m is taken from an explicit statement in Note 6, which describes it as a 'deterioration'. This figure is prioritized over a calculation from the gross claims development triangle, which yielded a different total, as the note is a direct statement of the adjustment made.
